channel.title: The Grant Desk - Open Calls, AI & Safety, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Open Calls, AI & Safety, UK, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 15 Jun 2026 (15 Jun to 21 Jun 2026).

  • SOUND/IMAGE 2026: "Artistic Intelligence" - Call for Works
    University of Greenwich · deadline Closed 19 Jun 2026 · No payment to artists. All accepted artists must purchase a festival pass at a reduced rate of £25 (covers catering and technical support).

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
